findings.source_passage: not excluding its suburbs. Such, and so magnifying, is the virtue of a large and liberal theme!
findings.source_locator: third paragraph, after 'throughout the whole universe'
findings.why_it_matters: The phrase 'not excluding its suburbs' is a characteristically Melvillean comic deflation after enormous cosmic enumeration — a signature micro-joke that defines the narrator's ironic register. Its excision flattens the rhetorical arc of the paragraph's climax.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore 'throughout the whole universe, not excluding its suburbs' before the aphoristic summary sentence.

findings.source_passage: though many there be who have tried it
findings.source_locator: end of third paragraph, after 'No great and enduring volume can ever be written on the flea'
findings.why_it_matters: This deadpan parenthetical ('though many there be who have tried it') supplies the comic puncture that completes the aphorism; without it the line reads as earnest rather than wry.
findings.suggested_fix: Append ', though many there be who have tried it' to restore the comic tail of the aphorism.

findings.source_passage: wine-vaults, cellars, and cisterns of all sorts
findings.why_it_matters: The absurdist accumulation of subterranean spaces (wells, wine-vaults, cellars, cisterns) is part of the chapter's comic self-credentialing voice; trimming to just 'ditches, canals and wells' loses the rhetorical excess that is itself the joke.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore 'wine-vaults, cellars, and cisterns of all sorts' to complete the list of Ishmael's geological credentials.

summary: The draft is substantially faithful, preserving all high-priority signatures verbatim, including the 'Give me a condor's quill' passage, the Saturn/Polar eternities paragraph, the Ahab/Pharaoh/Methuselah sequence, and the John Leo quotation in full; three minor voice-flattening losses (the 'suburbs' joke, the flea-book tail, and the wine-vault list) are low-severity and do not trigger regeneration.
